private: Welcome to Finances — your personal financial assistant! 📊 Here is what I can do for you: 💱 Smart Currency Conversion: Simply send me an amount and a currency (e.g., 100 USD or 50 EUR 20 GBP), and I'll instantly convert it to your preferred currencies. 🪙 Crypto & Stocks: Use the /crypto and /stocks commands to track live market prices for your favorite digital assets and top companies. 💼 Personal Portfolio: Manage your assets via /portfolio and view your total net worth effortlessly. 🔔 Price Alerts: Set custom target prices for any currency pair and I'll notify you the moment they hit! Use the /alert command. 💡 Pro Tip: You can use me in any chat! Just type @fStatisticsBot 100 USD anywhere to convert money on the fly. 👥 Add me to your group chats and I'll automatically convert any money amounts mentioned by your friends!
group: Finances Group Manager — auto-converting currencies for everyone! 🤖 Whenever someone mentions an amount in a supported currency, I will automatically reply with its equivalent in your selected output currencies. Use the settings panel in private messages to configure exactly which currencies I should listen to and which ones I should convert them to. Note: To view cryptocurrency rates in groups, use the /crypto command.

main: 📖 Finances Bot User Guide Available Commands: 🏠 /start - Open the Main Menu 💼 /portfolio - Manage your Investment Portfolio 🪙 /crypto - View Cryptocurrency Market 📈 /stocks - View Stock Market 🔔 /alert - Manage Price Alerts 💰 /expense_manager - Open the Expense Manager App ⚙️ /settings - Configure Language & Currencies ☕ /donate - Support the project ℹ️ /help - Show this guide 🔐 /privacy - Read the Privacy Policy Quick Examples: 💱 Converting Money: Just type 100 USD or 50 EUR to see it converted instantly. 📊 Inline Mode: Type @fStatisticsBot 100 USD in any chat with your friends to convert money on the fly! If you encounter any issues, don't hesitate to contact support.
q&a: 💬 Frequently Asked Questions: Q: The bot says it doesn't recognize my currency. What should I do? A: Make sure you use standard 3-letter currency codes (like USD, EUR, GBP) or standard symbols ($, €). Slang terms might not always be recognized. Q: Can I convert multiple currencies at once? A: Absolutely! Just type them out together: 100 USD 50 EUR 20 GBP. Still need help? Click the Contact Support button below!

text: 🔐 Privacy Policy for Finances Bot (@fStatisticsBot) 🛡 Data We Collect: • Basic Telegram profile info (Name, Username, ID) to identify your account. • Your chosen currency settings, language preferences, and portfolio data. • We never log or store your personal chat messages or group conversations. 🔒 Data Protection: • Your preferences are stored securely and never sold or shared with third parties. • The bot only processes messages containing numbers and currency codes. ✅ Your Rights: • You can request a complete deletion of all your data at any time by contacting the administrator. By using this bot, you consent to this policy. Thank you for trusting Finances!

mini app: 💼 Finances Manager 📊 Analyze your expenses and income easily. 💰 Track your savings and stay on top of your budget. 📈 Monitor your entire financial portfolio in real-time. Plan, save, and invest — all in one place! 🚀
